title: AID Protocol v2 — ReleaseDecision
$comment: producer: C4, consumers: [FSM, PM brief, GUI]
description: Artifact emitted by C4 (release controller) carrying the final release-readiness decision, references to every evidence input that contributed to it, and the 11 explicit D11 state fields the FSM merge gate and PM brief read directly (never inferring state).

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

release_decision.$comment: enforced — release_ready (exit 15) and the 11 D11 state fields (exit 16) are validated by aid-protocol-validate.sh; dual_run is OPTIONAL and FSM-patched in a later step.

release_ready.$comment: enforced (exit 15) — the FSM merge gate reads this directly

decided_by.description: Identifier of the controller/agent that produced this decision.

inputs.description: Every evidence input that contributed to the decision.

head_match.$comment: E-060-2_2 Step 8 — at-HEAD basis is per-input (plan_review=ancestry, gates_report=direct compare, markdown=Head: provenance). An UNCOMPUTABLE basis is the JSON string "unknown" (NEVER a silent true); "unknown" never counts as at-head; only false blocks.

blockers.description: Inputs that block release, keyed by canonical input_id.

input_id.$comment: P068 E-068-1_2 Step 4 — CLOSED oneOf, not a widened enum. A finite enum cannot express `epic_rollup:<epic_id>` for arbitrary future EPIC IDs, so the second branch is a pattern rather than more members. It stays closed in both directions: a typo in a canonical id still fails (branch 1), and a malformed EPIC id in a roll-up blocker still fails (branch 2). `delivery_report` joins branch 1 because plan mode's Reporter input is the run-scoped delivery-report.json.

waivers_applied.description: References to waiver artifacts applied to this decision.

waiver_findings.description: E-060-2_2 Step 8 — per-waiver disposition. A waiver NEVER unblocks (release_ready calc unchanged, D11 *_status unchanged); it maps a waiver file to a canonical input_id and, if that input is blocked, flips ONLY that inputs[] row blocked→waived while the blocker line stays. A waiver with no canonical mapping, or mapping to a non-blocked input, is an orphan_waiver.

dual_run.description: OPTIONAL — C4 dual-run comparison against the legacy path. Present but NOT required; enforcement is FSM-patched in a later step.
dual_run.$comment: reference — not validated by aid-protocol-validate.sh in this phase

delivered_summary_ref.$comment: enforced (exit 16) — D11 required-but-nullable: key must be present, value may be null

plan_summary.description: PLAN mode only (P068 Step 4) — absent for every EPIC-mode decision. The substrate aid-pm-brief.sh renders the plan-level PM summary from, so the renderer still reads exactly ONE file (the D6/D9 cycle-break). reviewed_candidate_sha, approved_target_sha, final_merge_sha and release_tag_status are four DISTINCT fields so a PM summary can never imply an intermediate EPIC was released; final_merge_sha is null until the plan is merged to the target branch.
